query_en: Does enabling foreign key constraints in SQLite require a setting for each connection? What happens if the setting is changed during a transaction?
Do PostgreSQL unique constraints treat rows containing NULL as duplicates? Is there a setting to treat NULL values as duplicates of each other?
With a read-only Docker bind mount, are nested submounts also read-only? Does this differ by Linux kernel version?
When a Kubernetes Secret is used as a volume, when are changes to its values reflected? Are mounts using subPath also updated automatically?
What must be specified to send cookies to another origin using browser fetch? What restrictions apply to cookie SameSite settings and server-side permissions?
What happens to the expiration of a Redis key set with EXPIRE when it is updated using SET or INCR? What happens when the expiration is set to zero or a negative value?
Does calling a Go context CancelFunc wait for the operation to finish? What problems arise if the cancellation function is left uncalled?
Does S3 ListObjectsV2 return results in the same order for regular buckets and directory buckets? Is the token used to retrieve subsequent results an actual key name?
